BiblicalUsage: Bereavement is the loss of children, and Babylon is told it is coming. I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children, she says; but these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood. David knows the other side: they rewarded me evil for good, to the spoiling of my soul.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bereavement is the wound no proverb can dress. Babylon boasted she would never know it, and it came in one day, and I hold that God sees the bereaved even when the proud do not.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
